name: Tiny Toon Adventures
description: Follow the adventures of a group of young cartoon characters who attend the Acme Looniversity to become the next generation of characters from the Looney Tunes series.

videos.title: Spring Break Special
videos.overview: The gang go to Florida for Spring Break. Elmyra goes in hunt of the Easter, who she thinks is Buster. She gets Tommy Lee Jones (in his Fugitive role) to help her. Plucky tries to sell his new invention, the Tan Master 2000 and sees his dream girl. We also get to meet Hamton's grandparents as Elmyra chases after Buster and Babs.

videos.title: Night Ghoulery
videos.overview: A one-hour special parodying various Halloween movies and stories

videos.title: From Looney Tunes to Tiny Toons -  A Wacky Evolution
videos.overview: DVD Special Feature

videos.title: How I Spent My Vacation
videos.overview: A direct-to-video feature-length film released on VHS and LaserDisc between the broadcast of Tiny Toon Adventures seasons 2 and 3. Featuring the characters from the Tiny Toon Adventures animated series, the plot follows their summer break.

videos.title: The Looney Beginning
videos.overview: Bugs Bunny helps Buster and Babs pull together their new series.

videos.title: A Quack in the Quarks
videos.overview: Plucky Duck tells aliens he is a perfect earth specimen.

videos.title: The Wheel O' Comedy
videos.overview: Buster and Babs are replaced by the Wheel of Comedy.

videos.title: Test Stressed
videos.overview: Plucky tries to cheat on a math exam; Sylvester gives Furrball an assignment to catch a mouse; a swearing Rooster asks Buster to help him get a date with Shirley.

videos.title: The Buster Bunny Bunch
videos.overview: Buster is intimidated at the gym; Dizzy gets some justice; Babs drives her friends away.

videos.title: Her Wacky Highness
videos.overview: Babs leaves Acme Acres.

videos.title: Hollywood Plucky
videos.overview: Plucky Duck plugs his script in Hollywood.

videos.title: Journey to the Center of Acme Acres
videos.overview: Buster and Babs set out to set out to rescue Hamton and Plucky from a crevice left by an earthquake and discover the source of the recent tremblings of the ground.

videos.title: It's Buster Bunny Time
videos.overview: The gang spoofs Howdy Doody in "Buster Bunny Bunch," the Roadrunner/Wiley Coyote competition in "Bag That Bunny," Robin Leach in "Lifestyles Of The Rich And Rotten" and classic al music in "The Anvil Chorus."

videos.title: Stuff That Goes Bump in the Night
videos.overview: Buster's poltergeist comes back to haunt Montana Max after he drops a house on the rabbit in "Home Wrecker." Elmyra's pet-of-the-month club delivers a vampire bat in "Fang You Very Much." And Hamton faces off against a mosquito in "Easy Biter."

videos.title: Looking Out for the Little Guy
videos.overview: Elmyra adopts Sneezer when he's left on her doorstep in "Awful Orphan." Plucky tries to stop Montana in "The Re-Return Of The Toxic Revenger," and a dog tries to protect baby chickens from the prowling Furrball in "Bird-Dog Afternoon."

videos.title: Starting From Scratch
videos.overview: A flea makes a courageous journey to find his family in a spoof of "An American Tail."

videos.title: Hare Raising Night
videos.overview: Buster goes on a mission to stop the mutant experiments of Dr. Gene Splicer.

videos.title: Furrball Follies
videos.overview: Furrball pretends to be a dog when he meets a blind couple who hates cats in "K-9 Kitty." In "Aroma Amore," a paint stripe down Furrball's back attracts Fifi.

videos.title: The Acme Acres Zone
videos.overview: A "Twilight Zone" spoof including "A Walk On The Flip Side," where rabbit-hating Montana wakes up as a bunny; "A Bacon Strip," in which Hamton is duped into skinny-dipping; and in "Senserely Yours, Babs," Babs loses her sense of humor.

videos.title: Life in the 1990's
videos.overview: Hamton takes Plucky and the Bunnys to a fancy restaurant in "Whining Out," Max tries to bilk Buster in "Paper Trained," and Babs fights smokers in "Butt Out."

videos.title: Rock 'N Roar
videos.overview: Buster accidentally hatches a dinosaur.

videos.title: Prom-ise Her Anything
videos.overview: The toons battle over Acme Loo's prom.

videos.title: Hare Today, Gone Tomorrow
videos.overview: Elmyra captures Buster, who must bust out of her cuddly prison.

videos.title: Cinemaniacs!
videos.overview: Buster and Babs browse the huge selection of films at their local theatre, including "Superbabs," "Duck Trek" and "Pasadena Jones."

videos.title: You Asked for It
videos.overview: Plucky tries to fix the rigged "request day" machine.

videos.title: Gang Busters
videos.overview: Max frames Buster, who gets sent to prison with his lawyer, Plucky.

videos.title: Citizen Max
videos.overview: Hamton is a reporter who tries to uncover the meaning of Montana Max's uttered "Acme."

videos.title: Wake Up Call of the Wild
videos.overview: The Bunnys consider instinct and their relation to the wild creatures.

videos.title: Buster and the Wolverine
videos.overview: A parody of "Peter And The Wolf."

videos.title: You Asked for It, Part II
videos.overview: Dizzy and Hamton are "The Weird Couple," Plucky takes on Monty's polluting factory in"The Return Of The Toxic Revenger" and Hamton clings to his diet in "Little Cake Of Horrors."

videos.title: Europe in 30 Minutes
videos.overview: Plucky, Hamton and the Bunnys go abroad for a tour of Europe.

videos.title: The Wacko World of Sports
videos.overview: Bjorn Bunny thwarts Max's rigged tennis tournament in "Tennis The Menace." Dizzy and Furrball try to fool Arnold in "Bleacher Bummer," and the Vanderbunnys teach Roderick and Rhubella a lesson in "Miniature Goof."

videos.title: Rainy Daze
videos.overview: The bored toons act up on a rainy day. Max's rent-a-friend delivery turns out to be an old enemy in "Rent A Friend." A napping Babs dreams in "Bunny Daze," and the Bunnys tunnel toward Aruba but make a wrong turn in "Fur-Gone Conclusion."

videos.title: Fields of Honey
videos.overview: Babs searches for a female role model.

videos.title: Sawdust and Toonsil
videos.overview: The toons try to free Wackyland creatures trapped in a circus sideshow.

videos.title: Spring in Acme Acres
videos.overview: Concord takes over Cupid's job in "Love Among The Toons." Elmyra goes wild while cleaning house in "Elmyra's Spring Cleaning" and Plucky and Dizzy battle for prizes on a humiliating game show in "That's Incredibly Stupid."

videos.title: Psychic Fun-Omenon Day
videos.overview: Calamaty Coyote sees his life flash before his eyes in "Piece Of Mind." Hamton wimps out of dissecting a frog in class in "Class Cut-Up." A bored Plucky uses binoculars to snoop from his hospital bed in "Rear Window Pain."

videos.title: The Wide World of Elmyra
videos.overview: Tyrone Turtle must cross a highway to escape Elmyra in "Turtle Hurdle." Elmyra bungles her babysitting in "Drooley Davey" and friendly dog Barky Marky loses his love of fetch after playing with Elmyra in "Go Fetch."

videos.title: A Ditch in Time
videos.overview: Plucky builds a time machine to avoid failing a class.

videos.title: Animaniacs!
videos.overview: Plucky rushes to do his Animation 101 project at the last moment.

videos.title: Career Oppor-Toon-ities
videos.overview: The toons get part-time jobs. As fast-food workers the Bunnys must serve Max in "Buster's Guide To Part Time Jobs." Toy salesman Hamton assists Elmyra in "Working Pig."

videos.title: Strange Tales of Weird Science
videos.overview: A scientist spills a hunger-inducing flavor-enhancer on Hamton in "Scentimental Pig." Sweetie programs Furrball to want to eat "Pit Bullied." Plucky the Toxic Revenger attacks Max's polluting ice-cream-spoon factory in "Duck In The Muck."

videos.title: Inside Plucky Duck
videos.overview: The Bunnys travel through Plucky's brain and encounter a costumed Plucky relating the story of his superhero adventures in "Bat's All Folks." Plucky gets stuck in the all-eyeball state on class picture day in "Wild Takes Class."

videos.title: The Acme Bowl
videos.overview: Acme Loo's winless season is no deterence to Perfecto kids determined to ensure their team will win the game.

videos.title: Dating, Acme Acres Style
videos.overview: Buster and Babs create the rules as they go on a date in "Buster's Guide To Dating." Fifi thinks a tarred and feathered Calamity is another skunk in "Love Stinks." And Elmyra looks for love on "The Dating Game."

videos.title: Looniversity Daze
videos.overview: Buster's friends worry about his safety when he's sent to the principal's office in "The Learning Principal," Sweetie searches for Bookworm in "Eating Between The Lines" and Plucky runs into Elmyra when he fakes illness in "What's Up Nurse."

videos.title: Best O' Plucky Duck Day
videos.overview: Plucky panics as Granny begins quizzing the class and handing out homework punishments for wrong answers in "One Minute Till Three." Plucky swipes a candy bar in "Sticky Feathers Duck".

videos.title: Hero Hamton
videos.overview: Hamton faces off against Montana Max.

videos.title: Whale's Tales
videos.overview: The toons set out to restore a kidnapped baby whale and punish its abducter.

videos.title: Ask Mr. Popular
videos.overview: Dizzy's transformed into the perfect friend when Mr. Popular hooks him up to a personality implanter in "Dapper Diz." Hamton's imaginary friends turns into a jerk in "A Pigment Of His Imagination."

videos.title: Son of Looniversity Daze
videos.overview: Plucky's guilt drives him insane in "Plucky's Dastardly Deed," Hamton is frustrated by his hyper-intelligent locker in "Open And Shut Case" and Plucky, Buster and Hamton try to move a piano down from the top of a tower in "C Flat Or B Sharp?"

videos.title: Mr. Popular's Rules of Cool
videos.overview: Hamton tries to get into a cool dance club in "Mr. Popular's Rules Of Cool," Plucky and Hamton compete in a parody of "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" in "Slugfest" and Max hunts a street-smart deer in "Venison Anyone?"

videos.title: Fairy Tales for the 90's
videos.overview: Buster is mistaken for a brought-to-life toy in "Bunnochio," and Elmyra plays Goldilocks in "Bear Necessities."

videos.title: Who Bopped Bugs Bunny?
videos.overview: Daffy is framed for the kidnapping of Bugs Bunny, and the tiny toons try to break him out of jail while solving the crime.

videos.title: Tiny Toon Music Television
videos.overview: Max sings motown, Buster spoofs the Sorcerer's Apprentice and Babs performs "Respect" in this parody of MTV.

videos.title: The Return to the Acme Acres Zone
videos.overview: Another Zone show, and this time, Babs gets in the act. Real Kids Don't Eat Broccoli: Buster is a futuristic private detective who is hired to find a pretty lady's androids. This search leads him to a club where he is met by thre pretty lady and her friends. It turns out that all of the kids are eating broccoli and Buster uncovers them as the missing droids. He destroys them with a computer virus and takes the droids back to the real lady. When asked how he knew about the droids in disguise, Buster replies ""Real kids don't eat broccoli"".

videos.title: The Acme Home Shopping Show
videos.overview: Buster and Babs host a home shopping network styled show and features a lot of shorts. Oh, For Art's Sake: Plucky needs an art project done, and so he resorts to pausing all of the action of a dog and cat fight with his VCR remote and submitting it as artwork. He become very popular and opens his own gallary featuring paused-action cat and dogs. Buster discovers the remote and brings all of the fighting animals to life right in the middle of the gallery! Then, Plucky is given his just desserts when he is put in a painting with fighting cats and dogs.

videos.title: Weirdest Story Ever Told
videos.overview: Buster and Babs have fun at the Acme Looniversity Library, where they have to face the wrath of loud librarian Foghorn Leghorn. Robin Hare: This rendition of ""Robin Hood"" features Buster and his merry men fighting the Sheriff of Naughty Ham (Montana Max) to get the money back to the poor.

videos.title: Viewer Mail Day
videos.overview: Buster and Babs answer mail from faithful viewers. Pluck of the Irish: Plukcy and Hamton spend the night in an Irish castle to get rid of a sad Banshee.

videos.title: Son of the Wacko World of Sports
videos.overview: The Wacko World of Sports strikes again! Buster at the Bat: This episode is a parody of the famous ""Casey at the Bat"" poem with a twist ending. Buster makes a home run at the end of the game.

videos.title: Pollution Solution
videos.overview: Toxic Revenger fights litterbugs; rain forest; toxic waste in Wackyland.

videos.title: You Asked for It Again
videos.overview: Buster procrastinates; Elmyra is locked in a mall; an ant hates sugar.

videos.title: Brave Tales of Real Rabbits
videos.overview: Buster, Babs and Max do a version of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Moriarity. Then Buster-as-knight must rescue damsel-in-distress Babs.

videos.title: How Sweetie It Is
videos.overview: An eagle thinks he's Sweetie's father. Sweetie is insulted when Furrball declines to eat her. Sweetie performs as Poe's famous bird.

videos.title: New Character Day
videos.overview: A host of new characters are auditioned, including The Roches, singing roach sisters who play in Hamton's kitchen. Then Plucky dreams he's a private eye.

videos.title: Here's Hamton
videos.overview: Plucky and Buster try to make Hamton laugh so hard he'll snort milk out his nose. Then a television program convinces Plucky that Hamton's a wanted criminal.

videos.title: No Toon is an Island
videos.overview: Buster, Babs, Hamton and Plucky search for treasure despite warnings of a certain green-eyed monster.

videos.title: K-ACME TV
videos.overview: Buster and Babs take over the television station.

videos.title: High Toon
videos.overview: Buster and Babs become lost in a ghost town being terrorized by coyote bandits.

videos.title: Pledge Day
videos.overview: Grandmother visits; a lifeguard; a bug meets a kite.

videos.title: Going Places
videos.overview: The gang become junior firefighters; paintings come to life; tour of a slaughterhouse.

videos.title: Elephant Issues
videos.overview: Dizzy Devil learns to read; a robot goes to college.

videos.title: Hog-Wild Hamton
videos.overview: Hamton's parents leave him home alone.

videos.title: Playtime Toons
videos.overview: Birthday gifts; Max's father takes his toys away; Furrball plays with a ribbon.

videos.title: Toon Physics
videos.overview: Elmyra's doll comes to life; Babs and Plucky count their yearbook pictures.

videos.title: Acme Cable TV
videos.overview: Sendups of television shows.

videos.title: Buster and Babs Go Hawaiian
videos.overview: Buster and Babs perform a tropical new script sent in by eighth graders.

videos.title: Henny Youngman Day
videos.overview: A bombing at a comedy club; potty training; Buster's joke dies.

videos.title: Love Disconnection
videos.overview: The girls seek classy prep-school guys; Monty's evening with Elmyra.

videos.title: Kon Ducki
videos.overview: Plucky spoofs the Kon-Tiki voyage.

videos.title: Sepulveda Boulevard
videos.overview: The Toons do "Sunset Boulevard."

videos.title: Take Elmyra Please
videos.overview: Elmyra is kidnapped.

videos.title: Thirteensomething
videos.overview: The problems of Toon teens.

videos.title: New Class Day
videos.overview: Plucky is "Batduck"; silent movies; Marx-Brothers-style mayhem in a hotel.

videos.title: Fox Trot
videos.overview: Hamton destroys Plucky's bagpipe; Elmyra learns about friendship; Steven Spielberg calls.

videos.title: What Makes Toons Tick
videos.overview: Buster explores the Toons' personalities.

videos.title: Flea For Your LIfe
videos.overview: A family of fleas breaks free of a tyrannous tick.

videos.title: The Return of Batduck
videos.overview: Plucky wants a part in "Batman."

videos.title: Toons Take Over
videos.overview: The Toons take over the animation studio.

videos.title: Toons From the Crypt
videos.overview: Buster hosts a horror show.

videos.title: Two-Tone Town
videos.overview: The Toons save old cartoon characters.

videos.title: Buster's Directorial Debut
videos.overview: Buster directs two cartoons.

videos.title: Washingtoon
videos.overview: The Toons go to Washington.

videos.title: Toon TV
videos.overview: The Toons make more music videos.

videos.title: Grandma's Dead
videos.overview: Elmyra's grandmother is believed dead.

videos.title: Music Day
videos.overview: A folk singer; Sneezer's stinky trumpet; dancing partners.

videos.title: The Horror of Slumber Party Mountain
videos.overview: The Toons get spooked while camping.

videos.title: Sports Shorts
videos.overview: Plucky plays golf; Elmyra goes under the sea.

videos.title: Weekday Afternoon Live
videos.overview: The Toons send up "Saturday Night Live."

videos.title: A Cat's Eye View
videos.overview: A dog finds a new owner; Plucky crashes a party; homeless.

videos.title: Best of Buster Day
videos.overview: Buster prevents Yosemite Sam's promotion; Monty fires his butler; a class assignment.

videos.title: It's a Wonderful Tiny Toons Christmas Special
videos.overview: Buster Bunny feels down after the failure of his play and wishes he had never become a Tiny Toon, so a Guardian angel shows Buster what life would have been like without him.
